author: NorthEast News Desk
body: A Middlesex County grand jury has indicted Timothy Scalisi, 31, of Waltham in connection with the death of 23-year-old Nicholas Dagostino, prosecutors announced Friday. Scalisi was arraigned in Middlesex Superior Court on charges including manslaughter after an alleged May assault.

Dagostino died at Lahey Hospital and Medical Center in Burlington on May 29, two days after the encounter. Authorities have described the case as a fatal assault following a confrontation. At Friday’s arraignment, bail was set at $10,000, according to local reports. Scalisi was also ordered to remain in Massachusetts, surrender his passport and avoid contact with Dagostino’s family and witnesses.

An indictment is a formal accusation and does not establish guilt. The prosecution will still need to prove the charges beyond a reasonable doubt in court, and Scalisi is entitled to the presumption of innocence. Moving the case to Superior Court advances it from the initial arrest and district-court stage into felony proceedings, where future hearings will address evidence, motions and scheduling before any trial or other resolution.
dek: Timothy Scalisi was arraigned in Superior Court after a grand jury charged him in the May death of Nicholas Dagostino.
headline: Waltham man indicted on manslaughter charge in fatal May assault
